title: Underlying Chern arrow with canonical abelian-tower endpoints
statement: For ChernData c [def-sp-tower-class-chern] with variable ring towers R and A and their system-ring map, underlyingChernArrow takes an integral coefficient-linear arrow f:unit R→rootModule[2] to the actual abelian-tower arrow from integers to roots[2]. It is the single map of integerGenerator, followed by mapSingleArrow for the recorded exact forgetting functor, followed by the shifted single map of rootForget. Its endpoint category and derived witnesses are explicitly those of Ab T [def-sp-tower-class-systems]. No source, target or scalar normalization is assumed.

source.place: clause (2), evaluation gives the finite Kummer first Chern class; expanded SmoothPurityTowerClasses proof, steps 5--8

proof.text: Construct underlyingChernArrow by specializing underlyingSingleArrow to the actual forgetful functor, integerGenerator and c.rootForget.hom. This gives the original exact composite, with fixed canonical abelian-tower endpoints.

proof_origin.place: clause (2), underlying integral arrow in the finite evaluation calculation
